_comment: Sample .claude/settings.local.json (personal layer, gitignored). bootstrap-to-new-project.sh deploys this to <target>/.claude/settings.local.json with /Users/your-name/Desktop/MY-NEW-PROJECT/** placeholders replaced by the real target path. Contains per-developer paths, bypass envs, and personal CLI tools. Universal rules live in settings.json. See dev-rule/sample/README.md.
